about:
Surplus Electronics Sales operates from Arcanum, Ohio. The company has been in business for 11 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. It serves academic institutions, hobbyists, and service personnel. Ownership details are not provided.

The company functions as an online-only distributor of surplus electronic components, offering over 1,000 distinct items across categories such as capacitors, resistors, diodes, fuses, connectors, integrated circuits, and more. Orders received before 1:00 PM Eastern typically ship the same day via USPS, with delivery in 2–5 business days. No physical storefront or phone ordering is available.

Its customer base includes academic institutions, hobbyists, service and repair personnel, and automotive sectors through products like automotive blade-type fuses. The catalog spans passive components, semiconductors, electromechanical devices, and test accessories.

The business emphasizes secure checkout via PayPal and Comodo SSL, same-day fulfillment for early orders, and a broad selection of surplus inventory. No founding mission or unique origin story is stated beyond serving the electronics community with low-cost surplus parts.
